name: State-Space Exhaustion Framing
description: Translate a clique/triangle condition into an equivalent condition that "all 2^k possible assignments of these k items to 2 bins violate at least one binary constraint". Models that fail to deduce the mathematical equivalence will implement the 2^k state-space check inside a naive nested loop instead of recognizing it as a graph triangle, preventing them from using graph-theoretic optimizations like bitset intersections and causing a Time Limit Exceeded error.
